list.name: branch
list.label: Filialas
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT BranchCode FROM bi.vIncomesOrders ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Bendra skola
panels.description: Neanuliuoti užsakymai, kurių vertė viršija sumokėtą sumą.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(ValueEur - PaidEur), 0) AS [Bendra skola], COUNT(*) AS [Neapmokėtų užsakymų skaičius] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND ValueEur - PaidEur > 0.005 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT BranchCode AS [Filialas], SUM(ValueEur - PaidEur) AS [Skola], COUNT(*) AS [Užsakymų skaičius] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND ValueEur - PaidEur > 0.005 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY BranchCode ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Skola pagal užsakymo amžių
panels.description: Amžius dienomis nuo užsakymo datos iki šiandien.

targets.rawSql: SELECT b AS [Užsakymo amžius], SUM(debt) AS [Skola], COUNT(*) AS [Užsakymų skaičius] FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a <= 30 THEN N'0-30 d.' WHEN a <= 60 THEN N'31-60 d.' WHEN a <= 90 THEN N'61-90 d.' ELSE N'virš 90 d.' END AS b, a, debt FROM (SELECT DATEDIFF(day, OrderDate, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AS a, ValueEur - PaidEur AS debt FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND ValueEur - PaidEur > 0.005 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) y) z GROUP BY b ORDER BY MIN(a)

SELECT TOP 500 OrderNo AS [Užsakymas], CONVERT(varchar(10), OrderDate, 120) AS [Data], BranchCode AS [Filialas], ValueEur AS [Vertė], PaidEur AS [Sumokėta], ValueEur - PaidEur AS [Skola], Consultant AS [Konsultantas] FROM bi.vIncomesOrders WHERE Cancelled = 0 AND ValueEur - PaidEur > 0.005 AND BranchCode IN ($branch) AND CAST(OrderDate AS datetime) BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY ValueEur - PaidEur DESC
